records.origin: Charter review committee proposals placed on the ballot by the City Council
records.summary: Five charter propositions. Four passed. The mayor and council pay increase failed with a reported 1,393 against and 960 for.

records.origin: Charter Review Committee seated April 2020, first met July 2020 and monthly through December 2020. Public hearing July 20, 2021. Council called the election August 3, 2021.
records.summary: Thirteen charter amendments, Measures A through M. Only the outcome of Measure B is currently sourced, and only through later news coverage.
Reported as the last charter amendment before 2021. No measure list, ballot language or results located.

The date Copperas Cove voters adopted the original home rule charter has not been located online. A 1979 date is sometimes cited informally and is NOT treated as verified here. The certified copy filed with the Texas Secretary of State is the record that settles it.

records.type: Council adoption of codified charter text
records.summary: Not a charter election. The city council adopted the charter text that Municode prints. This is a codification event and is listed here because every history note in the current charter is measured against it. It does not establish when residents adopted the home rule charter.
